title: Local finite freeness and section comparison for exterior sheafification
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a sheaf of modules, U an open, r,n nonnegative integers, and e an isomorphism from M restricted to U to the free sheaf of rank r [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let E_n be the exterior sheaf of M, namely the sheafification of the presheaf P_n(W)=\bigwedge^n_{O_X(W)} M(W) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Then E_n restricted to U is isomorphic to the free sheaf indexed by the n-element subsets of Fin(r). Moreover, for every open V contained in U, the sheafification unit P_n(V) \to E_n(V) is bijective. This holds also for n=0, n>r, empty opens, and zero section rings.

source.place: Tag 0BRT (lemma-smooth-proper), determinant inversion, expanded by the coordinate arguments in lem-sc-exterior-dual-local-frames proof steps 1-3. The tag was read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BRT; it uses determinant inversion but does not state this coordinate lemma.

proof.text: Restrict e to every smaller open W. It gives an O_X(W)-basis of M(W) with r generators whose coordinates commute with all smaller-open restrictions. Take the increasing exterior basis. The exterior coordinates on pure wedges are determinants of the original coordinates. Ring restriction preserves those determinants, so the exterior basis identifies the restricted presheaf P_n with the finite product of O_X indexed by the n-element subsets of Fin(r). Check naturality on pure wedges and extend by their spanning property.

The finite product of the structure sheaf on the localized open site is a sheaf: compatible sections glue coordinate by coordinate, and uniqueness follows coordinate by coordinate as well. On this finite index set it is the free sheaf. Localizing sheafification to U has the same universal factorization property as sheafification of the restriction, since any cover of a smaller open is unchanged by localization. Consequently its unit is an isomorphism on the localized site. This yields the asserted free-sheaf isomorphism and bijectivity of the unit on every V contained in U. The empty-subset basis for n=0 and empty index set for n>r require no separate ring hypotheses.

theorem exteriorSheaf_local_free_comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules)
    (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (r : ℕ)
    (e : M.over U ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) :
    Nonempty ((exteriorSheaf M n).over U ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Set.powersetCard (Fin r) n))) ∧
    ∀ (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U),
      Function.Bijective
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
          (exteriorSheafPresheaf M n)).app (op V))
